2609.34453.title: SPACE-LoRA: Allocating Activation-Subspace Protection for Continual Learning
2609.34453.paper_summary: This study addresses the catastrophic forgetting problem that occurs when sequentially learning successive tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) from a lifelong learning perspective. While existing approaches have primarily constrained parameter updates or learning subspaces to reduce interference with past knowledge, they have not fully considered additive interference. This occurs when a newly added residual adapter on top of a fixed past model generates non-zero responses along input directions important for old tasks, thereby altering previous predictions. To this end, we propose Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation (SPACE-LoRA). SPACE-LoRA directly suppresses the responses of the new residual branch along input activation directions that are important for old tasks and adaptively determines the protection coverage for each module based on past-task sensitivity estimated via a common Fisher sensitivity-based coverage target. Under a fixed LoRA rank, this approach adaptively adjusts module-specific protection coverage while suppressing interference along input directions sensitive to old tasks. We assess the effectiveness of activation-subspace protection in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and examine the role of sensitivity-guided protection in continual learning across diverse tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPACE-LoRA-7864.
2609.34453.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究從終身學習的角度探討了在連續學習後續任務時發生的災難性遺忘問題，並使用低秩適應（LoRA）。雖然現有的方法主要限制了參數更新或學習子空間以減少與過去知識的干擾，但它們並未充分考慮附加干擾。當在固定的過去模型上新增的殘差適配器沿著對舊任務重要的輸入方向產生非零響應時，就會發生這種情況，從而改變之前的預測。為此，我們提出了具有分配容量的子空間保護以實現高效持續適應（SPACE-LoRA）。SPACE-LoRA直接抑制沿著對舊任務重要的輸入激活方向的新殘差分支的響應，並根據通過共同Fisher敏感性估計的過去任務敏感性自適應地確定每個模塊的保護覆蓋範圍。在固定的LoRA秩下，這種方法自適應地調整模塊特定的保護覆蓋範圍，同時抑制對舊任務敏感的輸入方向的干擾。我們評估了激活子空間保護在減輕災難性遺忘方面的有效性，並檢查了敏感性引導保護在不同任務的持續學習中的作用。代碼可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPACE-LoRA-7864 獲得。
